narration: Red Dead Redemption, Grand Theft Auto Five, and Red Dead Redemption Two all expanded that exact system.
In those games, finishing a heist or shootout unlocked a checklist of bronze, silver, and gold medals.
title: cards
subtitle: THE MEDALS::BRONZE=Finish the job|SILVER=Do it well|GOLD=Do it perfectly

narration: You could open your pause menu anytime, select any past mission, and jump right back in.

title: ZERO GOLD MEDALS
subtitle: NO CHECKLISTS IN THE PROLOGUE

title: archive

narration: Clicking on a finished mission does nothing at all because Rockstar removed Mission Replay at launch.
title: archive

title: IN THE MENU

title: AUTOSAVE

narration: If you missed a branching path during a heist, you cannot reload that mission from the menu.
Why would Rockstar spend ten years building the most advanced open world ever and cut Mission Replay?

When law enforcement or rival syndicates burn a safehouse chapter down, that chapter’s tied bonuses vanish.

subtitle: HOW LONG::50H=Main story|200H=Platinum trophy

subtitle: 15 MANUAL SAVE SLOTS::1=PROLOGUE|2-13=EVERY 5-10%|14=PRE-FINALE|15=CHAOS

subtitle: SLOT 15::1-14=STORY|15=CHAOS

Both Jason and Lucia have independent Criminal Profiles that evaluate how you commit crimes across the state.

title: profile

title: profile

If you push a character’s brutality below Psychopath, the meter hits an irreversible cracked icon state.

subtitle: level=4

narration: Once that icon cracks on your active save file, you can never restore your Professional profile again.

subtitle: NO WAY BACK ON THAT SAVE

IGN confirmed that Grand Theft Auto Six is the first entry built specifically to encourage player empathy.
title: BUILT FOR EMPATHY
subtitle: IGN'S LAUNCH REVIEW

title: MULTIPLE ENDINGS
subtitle: CONFIRMED

That is why IGN explicitly warned players to keep a separate save file before going on rampages.

subtitle: KEEP IT APART::1-14=STORY|15=RAMPAGE

subtitle: UNLOCK THE CHEAT CODES

narration: Until you reach those credits, however, one unbacked rampage on your main save can alter your ending forever.
Even if you manage your fifteen save slots carefully, muscle memory from past Rockstar games can betray you.

subtitle: Muscle memory betrays you

narration: Remember how Red Dead Redemption Two players constantly shot town sheriffs in the face by mistake?
You would walk up to greet a stranger, tap the wrong trigger, and accidentally draw your revolver.
In a game where civilian murder permanently cracks your Criminal Profile, accidental shootings would be catastrophic.

subtitle: level=4

subtitle: SPRINT::OLD WAY=Mash X or A|NEW WAY=Click L3

title: controller
subtitle: SPRINT MOVED::L3=SPRINT

narration: They also separated the weapon draw input so you require a deliberate command before aiming a gun.
That prevents you from accidentally pulling a pistol when you are only trying to talk to NPCs.
Inside vehicles, however, the button changes require an immediate mental adjustment during your first police chase.
On PlayStation Five, the vehicle handbrake has been moved from R1 down to the X button.

subtitle: IN THE CAR::X=HANDBRAKE

narration: Rockstar made that change because L1 and R1 are now dedicated to aiming and firing while driving.
title: controller
subtitle: DRIVE-BY::L1=AIM|R1=FIRE|X=HANDBRAKE

You can no longer stand by the front wheel of a jumbo jet and teleport into the cockpit.
